bio: Romantic, stylish, luxurious; the Macdonald Compleat Angler Hotel is an award winning magical riverside retreat located in the town on Marlow. Located within close reach of London's Heathrow Aiport but still attractively placed on the banks of the well renowned River Thames, giving you the perfect opportunity to take in the water. You may be familiar with this hotel from author Jerome K Jerome, whose most famous work "Three Men in a Boat" celebrates the delightful charms of the Macdonald Compleat Angler Hotel.  Located within the Macdonald Compleat Angler, Bowaters is the ideal setting where a Traditional Afternoon Tea is served. Proudly showcasing an AA Rosette, Bowaters is sophisticated yet infinitely relaxed and during the summer the pretty terrace is opened to encapture a famous British summers day.  Afternoon Tea has always been a graceful and refined occasion, bringing people together for a brief hour's pleasure and refreshments, so why not take your group for Afternoon Tea at the Compleat Angler and relax to the sound of cascading waters of the Thames running over the town's weir.
